name: WARNING: Whole Globe Artichoke Leaves & Spiny Tips
whyItWorks: Whole steamed globe artichokes where diners scrape the bottom flesh of thick fibrous outer bracts. Inadvertently swallowing whole leaves or spiny tips can directly wedge into an intestinal narrowing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Strictly avoid whole globe artichokes if you have known intestinal strictures or an ileostomy. Choose canned tender artichoke hearts only.
